name: Catnip Arcade
summary: Catnip Arcade is four small cat games for iPhone and iPad. In Herding Kittens you steer a litter of hungry kittens to the food bowl with a laser dot and catnip. Kitty Jump is a 3D box climber starring Space Cat. Balloon Pop calls a color and you pop it, and every color also has its own shape. Emergency Stress Relief! is the same balloons with the rules taken out. You can pet the cat, and the purrs are the developer's own two cats, Samantha and Sabrina. Free, no ads, no account.
